notes.title: New Update 1.03
notes.content:
Made multiple fixes based on bug reports from players:

[list]
[*] leaderboard bug: some scores were in the wrong order, happened when the time difference was very small.
[*] leaderboard UI fixes: Sometimes the score list expanded outside the container.
[*] Level [4,3] fix: Fixed a dead-end at the last phase of the level.
[*] Level [4,2] fix: Moved a green teleporter that appeared just as the phase started, sometimes a whole part of the level was skipped by accident.
[*] Added a warning for players with photosensitive epilepsy
[/list]

notes.title: New Demo Update: version 0.22
notes.content:
A new version for the Ultratoro 2 Demo just released. Added features, made some fixes and tweaks:
[list]
[*] The camera system has been reworked. Now driving on the external side of a torus is not a death sentence.
[*] Added a progression bar on the death screen showing how close you where to finishing the level.
[*] Made various modifications on every stage, added more coins and improved frustrating sections.
[*] Reduced the duration of the invulnerable state following damage.
[/list]

notes.title: Ultratoro 2 on the Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Ultratoro 2 is joining the Steam Next Fest, with a [b]demo [/b] containing 
[list]
[*]5 levels.
[*]A final boss.
[*]5 unlockable cars.
[/list]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43572371/f9eb910f4af78e5d09b3b5c9b15c68dfce1da122.png[/img]

Break into into the internal network of a cult turned megacorporation. Your car is a hacking device that can navigate the toruspace: a virtual universe made of donut shapped worlds containing all of humanity's data.

See you on [b]Wed, June 21, 2023[/b]
